text: ムシに　さされちゃった　かな？

structure.jp: さされちゃった　かな？
structure.en: did I get bitten, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ムシに　さされちゃった
patterns.explanation: The れる ending turns 'to bite' into 'to get bitten', and に shows who did it. ムシに　さされちゃった = 'I got bitten by a bug'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is the short spoken form. さされちゃった = 'I went and got bitten'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.span: さされちゃった　かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means you are wondering to yourself. さされちゃった　かな = 'did I get bitten, I wonder'.
